transport: Identical to ecoflow-cloud-gen1-json — same REST host and HMAC-SHA256 signing, same /certification-issued MQTT broker, same /open/{certificateAccount}/{sn}/quota topics. Only the payload key namespace differs.
blocks: bms_bmsStatus.* (pack BMS), bms_bmsInfo.* (lifetime counters), bms_emsStatus.* (energy management), inv.*, mppt.*, pd.*. typeCode equivalents on MQTT: bmsStatus, bmsInfo, emsStatus, invStatus, mpptStatus, pdStatus.
gotchas: The gen-1 to gen-2 change is a container rename, not a new vocabulary. Every leaf name is the same: soc, soh, vol, amp, temp, cycles, designCap, fullCap, remainCap, maxCellVol, minCellVol, maxCellTemp, minCellTemp, f32ShowSoc, chgRemainTime, dsgRemainTime, lcdShowSoc, maxChargeSoc, minDsgSoc, maxCloseOilEbSoc, minOpenO

ioBroker normalises bms_bmsStatus back to a bmsMaster channel in its own object tree while still matching on both spellings at runtime (lib/ecoflow_utils.js checks bmsMaster.bqSysStatReg and bms_bmsStatus.bqSysStatReg in adjacent branches). Read its object names as its own naming, not as evidence the device emits bmsMa
Neither implementation exposes an AC frequency reading on this dialect — out_freq appears only as a write parameter. Do not assume ac-frequency is available.
No AC current is reported either, only AC volts and AC watts.
Cloud-only, same as gen-1. No LAN path exists for this model in any implementation reviewed.
unmappedReports: Everything unmapped in the gen-1 dialect applies unchanged, under the new prefixes (bms_bmsStatus.remainCap, bms_bmsStatus.maxCellVol, bms_emsStatus.chgRemainTime / dsgRemainTime, bms_emsStatus.minOpenOilEbSoc, pd.wattsInSum / wattsOutSum, the USB per-port watts)., bms_bmsInfo.accuChgCap / accuDsgCap (cumulative amp-hours charged and discharged over the pack's life) and accuChgEnergy / accuDsgEnergy (cumulative watt-hours in and out). These are pack lifetime totals; ac-energy-total and pv-energy-total are the wrong side of the meter, and there is no battery-energy-in / battery-energy-out MetricKind., mppt.pv2InVol / pv2InAmp / pv2InWatts — a second, independent MPPT input. MetricKind pv-power is scalar; a two-string charger needs either two devices or an indexed metric., pd.carWatts and mppt.carStandbyMin — 12 V car socket output and its idle timeout., inv.SlowChgWatts and the fastChgWatts setpoint — AC charge power in watts, again not expressible as set-charge-current-limit., Same all-in-one DeviceKind gap as the DELTA Pro.
